result:
Both typecheck and the test suite pass, including the 422 stack trace in `PostController.test.ts` which is pre-existing noise (the test still asserts and passes).

I fixed the bug by wiring up `routes/admin.ts`, which defined `registerAdminRoutes` but was never imported or called anywhere — so `/admin/posts` was never mounted on the router, hence the 404. In `routes/web.ts` I imported `registerAdminRoutes` from `./admin.js` and called it right after `registerAuthRoutes(router)`, using the same router that already has the `'auth'` alias middleware set up (which `admin.ts` requires via its `Router<'auth'>` type and uses to gate the route with `router.middleware('auth')`). I also added `tests/AdminPostController.test.ts`, asserting that a guest `GET /admin/posts` redirects to `/login` instead of 404ing, matching the project's existing lightweight test style (no DB fixtures). No changes were made to `AdminPostController` itself, which already implemented the correct behavior.
